purpose: Teach: 不本意/産出/公国/喘息/仰天/変異/転覆/大麻

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、不本意な役職に就いた人物史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you wrote your paper on reluctant historical figures who were forced into positions of power, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, curious opening. Gentle confirmation — not quite a question. Even pace. The tone of a teacher who has read the work and is inviting the student to talk about it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、資源産出地域の経済史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I looked at the economic history of resource-producing regions.
lines.style: Soft, slightly apologetic correction. Brief pause before speaking. Steady but not defensive. He's adjusting her assumption with quiet honesty.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、ヨーロッパの公国の歴史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, your paper covered the history of European principalities, is that right?
lines.style: Gentle re-check. Slight lilt at the end — genuinely uncertain this time. Warm but slower. She's clearly looking at her notes.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、都市部の喘息発症率を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Actually, I focused on asthma incidence rates in urban areas.
lines.style: Polite but clear. No apology in the voice — just straightforward. He speaks at a steady pace, meeting her eye implicitly through his tone.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 歴史的事件の仰天証言を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: I see you examined historical events through eyewitness accounts that were quite surprising.
lines.style: Brighter now, engaged. She's found something that sparks her interest. Faster pace. The 'I see' carries recognition, not frustration.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、ウイルスの変異研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Actually, I was researching viral mutations and how they evolve.
lines.style: Calm, patient. He's used to these misreadings. No edge to it — just gentle persistence in explaining. Quiet and deliberate.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、近代の政府転覆事例を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you investigated cases of government overthrow in modern history, correct?
lines.style: Slower now, thoughtful. She's reading from her notes but looking up more. The inflection of genuine curiosity mixed with mild embarrassment at the mismatches.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、大麻を巡る法政策史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: No, I wrote about the legal and policy history of cannabis legislation.
lines.style: Soft closing. No frustration — acceptance. Slight breath before speaking. The faintest trace of a smile in his voice, as if he finds the pattern touching rather than annoying.
